structuredContent.latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the critic stage in one native Goal and saved its exact activation and terminal responses. The Goal completed after **8 minutes 25 seconds**.

The review preserves the brief’s full scope. It tightens the in-place original guarantee, exact frame and sample boundaries, and independent drift validation. It also keeps native OTIO with namespaced metadata as a candidate to test; its documentation supports that option, while ffprobe cautions that interval seeking is approximate. [OTIO metadata documentation](https://opentimelineio.readthedocs.io/en/v0.18.0/tutorials/write-an-adapter.html) · [ffprobe documentation](https://ffmpeg.org/ffprobe.html)
